result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The reports module compiles offline (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test-compile`). I did not run any tests, because the reports module has none that cover contributors.

Changes, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on the contributor table stream and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. The sort order is unchanged. This method builds the All, Recent, bots and teams tables, so they all stop truncating.
- **`ContributorListsSection.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` in `getBarsHtml`, so the bar chart has one bar per recently active contributor.

The setting stays in `LandscapeConfiguration.java`, and I left it unchanged. The "limited to" note in `LandscapeRepositoriesReport.java` is a separate report for repositories, so I did not touch it. Nothing is committed.
